question: Which observation-only initialization reliably improves a squared Chebyshev TT across geometries?
pre_evaluation_amendment: Early throughput runs used 2000 KDE centers. Before selection or truth evaluation, repeat those KDE runs with the existing library default of 5000 centers; retain the early runs as legacy_kde2000 artifacts. Other recipes and optimizer settings are unchanged.
conversion_control: Before truth evaluation, add full_guided: exactly the same full-covariance EM pilot and seed as full, converted with a one-pass sampled-suffix TT cross using pilot means and draws. Backfill earlier cases. This isolates a data-informed conversion from uniform-box pivot search.
checkpoint_selection: minimum noisy validation NLL plus fixed amplitude H2 penalty, including step zero
initialization_selector: minimum step-zero noisy validation NLL plus fixed amplitude H2 penalty across candidate starts
screening_control: Before independent test or truth evaluation, compare seed-zero-only policies choosing by initial score, best score through400updates, or final score. With eight recipes, the retrospective screen costs8*400+800=4000 TTupdates vs9600 training all. No future score of a discarded arm is used.
postfit_selector: minimum selected-checkpoint noisy validation NLL plus fixed amplitude H2 penalty across candidate starts
general_recipe_comparison: equal-case average ranks of mean validation scores; report independent test scores and latent recovery only after fits and selectors are frozen
recovery_evaluation: independent signal samples for Hellinger/TV estimates plus integrated or defensive-importance L2 and pair marginals; truth only after fitting and selection
extension_rule: if feasible, longer matched runs of the KDE baseline and validation-winning non-KDE recipe on GL10 and swirl10; choose before any truth evaluation
scope: initialization sensitivity with fixed observations; the three seeds are not independent datasets
figures: PNG files in existing figs/convergence, figs/ginzburg_landau and figs/swirl directories; numerical results stay in artifacts
cryoem_transfer_rule: Before truth evaluation, freeze the recipe with best equal-case average validation rank on swirl4 and swirl10. If swirl recovery improves, transfer that recipe to cryo-EM under the earlier user request. Keep the eight-case general-purpose recommendation separate.
gaussian_conversion_control: Before independent test or truth evaluation: swirl10 moment-Gaussian pilot validation NLL is9.85082649, while the ordinary converted TT is13.03229376. Add gaussian_guided with exactly the same moment pilot and sample-guided Chebyshev TT conversion; backfill all8cases and3seeds. No other settings change.
